summary_en: Tender offer period extended from 25 June 2026 to 13 July 2026 (30 to 42 business days). Tender price ¥7,600/share unchanged. Minimum acceptance threshold 867,000 shares (30.29% of shares outstanding). Purpose: complete subsidiary of Gerbera holdings. Extension granted to provide shareholders additional consideration opportunity and accommodate timing of annual securities report filing.
title_en: Notice of Amendment – Gerbera holdings Public Tender Offer for Metalart Shares – Board Endorsement and Shareholder Recommendation Update
translation_en_brief: This is an amendment notice to Metalart's prior disclosure of 14 May 2026 regarding the public tender offer by Gerbera holdings for Metalart shares. The only change is an extension of the tender offer period. The original period was 15 May 2026 to 25 June 2026 (30 business days); it has been extended to 15 May 2026 to 13 July 2026 (42 business days). The tender price remains ¥7,600 per share. The minimum acceptance threshold is unchanged at 867,000 shares (30.29% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury stock). The objective remains complete subsidiary status under Gerbera holdings. The stated rationale for the extension is twofold: to provide Metalart shareholders with additional opportunity to consider their decision regarding the tender offer, and to accommodate the timing of Metalart's annual securities report filing (to be submitted 26 June 2026 for fiscal year ended 31 March 2026), which will necessitate amendments to the tender offer statement. No maximum cap on shares was disclosed in either version.
